deferral_rationale: Reconciler r1 severity downgrade (BLOCKER -> standing recommendation): the fence-blind regexes are the approved plan v4 Design section VERBATIM (plan lines 81-95), with both failure directions bounded — the false-refusal population measured empty (drain_rows_with_signature=0 for BOTH kinds, part-token prose collisions 0, independently re-run by the reconciler: would-fire 29/1529 + 98/1795, arming condition (a) holds) and --allow-nonconforming-report is the plan's registered escape for any residual false positive, while a false pass degrades to the pre-#2309 status quo (the check ADDS to code-review judgment, never replaces it). Fence-aware scanning is a legitimate hardening follow-up against the approved design, not a round defect.
